selection: Per chart timeframe, shared length for long/short, highest development total net R; baseline included, ties prefer baseline then shorter length. Only complete development trades; validation never selects.
common_warmup_sensitivity: All lengths and baseline additionally replay on a shared SMA200-ready eligibility clock; original V9 baseline separately preserved.
acceptance: Selected filter needs positive later total net R, positive improvement over baseline in net R and nominal net return, positive monthly-block delta lower95 bound and Holm adjusted one-sided p<0.01 across 3 selected TF tests; later realized10R retention>=0.85 where baseline has such winners. Common-warmup result must not reverse improvement. Otherwise research-only, no default replacement.
entry_rule: chart confirmation close strictly above last confirmed HTF SMA for long, below for short; equality and unknown reject
htf_visibility: HTF close_time <= chart bar OPEN; SMA[1]+lookahead_on semantics
unchanged: V9 raw reversals; next-open entry; original 5bar/0.2ATR/min2ATR stop; close2R arms4ATR trail; 0.2% round trip
